description: Compares buying a home against renting using actual period mortgage payments and symmetric investment of whichever scenario has lower cash costs. Mortgage contributions stop after payoff; purchase/sale costs, maintenance, rent inflation and investment returns are included. Use only to compare buying a Cyprus home with renting over a stated horizon. Use financial facts stated or confirmed for this scenario. Do not carry values from another chat or scenario into the calculation until the user explicitly confirms the relevant values. Ask for any missing core term: property price, monthly rent, down payment and whether it is EUR or percent, mortgage rate, and mortgage term. If the deposit is given without a unit (for example, '20'), ask whether it means EUR or percent before interpreting, converting, deriving a loan amount, or calling this tool. Never infer the unit from context. Optional growth, inflation and return assumptions require user acceptance when not stated. Mortgage payments end at payoff, and cost differences are invested by the lower-cost side. After calculating, briefly summarize every material modelling default used (including defaults supplied in the call) and costs excluded or treated as zero; use structuredContent.assumptions for defaults and exclusions returned by the API.

agencyFees.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

agentCommission.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

commonAreaExpenses.description: Monthly communal charges when renting, EUR.

downPayment.description: Deposit amount. If the user gives no unit, ask whether it is EUR or a percentage before interpreting or calculating.

downPaymentIsPercentage.description: True only when the user explicitly confirms the deposit is a percentage; false only when they explicitly confirm it is EUR. Ask if unclear; never infer.

fittingsFurniture.description: One-off furnishing cost when buying, EUR.

legalFees.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

maintenanceFixed.description: Annual maintenance in EUR when not using the percentage.

maintenancePercentage.description: Annual maintenance as a percent of property value (model default 1%).

mortgageInterestRate.description: Annual percentage value (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%). Supply the actual rate unless the user accepts a stated modelling default.

propertyPrice.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

rentFurniture.description: One-off furnishing cost when renting, EUR.

salesCommissionRate.description: Assumed selling commission on exit, percent (default 5%).

securityDepositMonths.description: Deposit expressed in months of rent.

stampDuty.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

transferFees.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

transferTaxOnSale.description: Assumed transfer tax on exit, percent (default 0%).

useMaintenancePercentage.description: Use the percentage instead of the fixed maintenance figure (default true).

name: compare_rent_vs_buy
